title: Freedom Convoy anniversary demonstration on Parliament Hill
organizer: Freedom Convoy representatives/supporters; formal organizer not identified in the read sources
participants_original: TVA reports approximately 100 truckers; CityNews reporter estimate is about 200 people, excluding police; Ottawa Lookout relays 200+ from CTV/councillor.
threshold_50_evidence: The body-read TVA report says approximately 100 truckers attended, and CityNews gives its reporter’s approximate estimate of 200 people excluding police. These are approximate reports, not bounds or an exact count, but each supports at least 50 attendees.

start_date.summary: TVA and CityNews identify the gathering as Saturday, January 28; Ottawa Lookout describes the anniversary weekend.

location.summary: The reports place the gathering at Parliament Hill / downtown Ottawa.

organizer.summary: TVA describes Freedom Convoy representatives; CityNews describes the anniversary gathering, but neither identifies a named formal organizer.

demands.summary: These reports describe an anniversary protest/dance party and do not identify a current, specific demand directed at Canada’s government or policy.

participants_original.summary: TVA: approximately 100 truckers; CityNews reporter: about 200 people excluding police; Lookout relays 200+ from CTV/councillor.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Both the approximately 100 truckers and approximately 200 attendees reports exceed 50; neither is treated as a precise count or numeric interval.

protester_violence.summary: TVA mentions aggression reported by police but does not attribute conduct to protesters; no protester-violence value can be established.

state_response.summary: Two trespass arrests are reported by TVA/CityNews (arrests=yes). Towings, parking tickets and provincial notices are not coded as crowd dispersal. Other response dimensions remain unknown.

end_date.summary: No explicit physical closing time or end date is established in these reports.

notes: Do not import the 2022 Freedom Convoy campaign demands into this anniversary gathering: no specific current state-directed demand is stated in the reviewed reports. The Sunday convoy attempt is recorded separately.
open_questions: Did demonstrators state a current demand directed at the Canadian government or policy?
Is the Jan. 29 convoy attempt a distinct event or part of the same organized weekend?
What were the gathering’s start/end times?
